118f9d064db52811.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate race, beating Republican Dan Sullivan
118f9d064db52811.summary: Alaska Democrat Mary Peltola has defeated incumbent Republican Sen. Dan S. Sullivan to flip yet another Senate seat for Democrats. Updated vote counts released Tuesday night gave Peltola just over 50% of the first-choice ballots, according to the Associated Press, allowing her to secure victory without having to rely on any second-choice ballots under the state s ranked-choice voting system.
